title: Nerfies · 视频优先的交互科研主页

description.zh: 以自动播放的视频 Hero、极简论文/代码入口和可操作的形变插值滑杆组织科研证据；此缩略图只是其交互模块的一帧。
description.en: A video-first academic site with compact paper/code actions and an interactive deformation slider; its thumbnail is a demo frame, not a viewport screenshot.

zh: 设计以动态视觉结果为核心、需要低门槛交互验证的学术主页。
en: Designing project sites whose strongest evidence is a dynamic rendering or user-controllable demo.

zh: 明确标题和资源链接置于首屏，视频演示紧接其后；可交互滑杆让读者主动观察模型在两端状态之间的变化。
en: A strong title and canonical links lead into a video hero; an interactive slider invites readers to inspect interpolation rather than view a static gallery.

zh: 本站仅外链一个网站交互素材作识别，不能据此称其为真实首屏截图；交互效果应打开原站体验。
en: Preview is one official demo frame, not a captured homepage; inspect the live site for behavior.
